name: Auto Materials
author: Tequila
description: Puts library materials on parts when a model comes in, by their names, their CAD materials and their assemblies: screws get steel, lenses glass, grips rubber, an aluminium part aluminium. Plastics keep the model's colours. Your own rules on top of the built-in ones, a preview, or the whole scene at a click.

commands.title: Auto Materials…
commands.description: Edit the rules, preview and apply them

commands.title: Apply the rules to every part
commands.description: Materials as one undo step, and the model's colours as another

fields.label: Your rules, first, one a line - words in a part's name: library material
fields.default:
screw, bolt, nut, washer, rivet, standoff: Stainless Brushed
glass, lens, window: Glass Clear
rubber, grip, foot, feet, gasket, seal, tyre, tire, o-ring: Rubber Black
chrome: Chrome
leather, strap: Leather Black
screen, display, lcd: Screen Glow

fields.label: And rules from a CSV file (words, material)
Then Tequila's own rules (about 60: fasteners, plastics, metals by alloy, prints, glass, rubber, wood)
Match the CAD file's material names and the assemblies too, not only the parts' names
Plastics and paints keep the colour the model gave the part
Leave parts that already have a library material
Apply them when a model is imported
